Which three sites have the lowest [Exper.text:
Our three weakest sites are only slightly below the global experience norm, but Fabrikam’s Lyon office stands out for crashes.

Against the all‑site experience score of 81.3:
- Fabrikam Industries Lyon: 79.4 vs 81.3; VPN latency 68 ms; Teams quality 4.09; 1,807 app crashes.
- Northwind Logistics Hamburg: 81.0 vs 81.3; VPN latency 45 ms; Teams 4.20; 427 crashes.
- Fabrikam Industries Lille: 81.0 vs 81.3; VPN latency 45 ms; Teams 4.20; 262 crashes.

### SOURCE
- Semantic model: SM_ServiceDesk_Analytics
- Dimension: dim_site[site_name]
- Measures: [Experience Score] (sorted ascending), [VPN Latency (ms)]
- Measures: [Teams MOS], [App Crashes]
- Benchmark: overall average [Experience Score] across all sites

Which customers breached an XLA in the l.text:
Only Fabrikam and Litware breached an experience commitment last week; Fabrikam owes money, Litware triggers a remediation plan only.

Compared with their commitments:
- Fabrikam Industries: zero‑touch 34.0% vs 40.0% target (was 46.0%); 1 breach, 9,250 EUR credit. Contract: “If the zero-touch resolution rate falls below 40.0% in any ISO week, Zava credits 5% of the monthly service fee…”.
- Litware Insurance: zero‑touch 38.0% vs 40.0% trigger (was 48.0%), 1 breach, 0 EUR credit. Contract: written remediation plan, no service credit.

### SOURCE
- Semantic model: SM_ServiceDesk_Analytics
- Dimension: dim_customer[customer_name]
- Measures: [XLA Breaches (Last Closed Week)], [XLA Credit (Last Closed Week)], [Zero-Touch % (Last Closed Week)], [Zero-Touch % (Previous Week)], [Zero-Touch Target %]
- Ontology: ONT_ServiceDesk
- Path: Customer–[:CustomerHasContract]→Contract–[:ContractDefinesXla]→Xla(metric='zero_touch_rate', clause_text, threshold, penalty_pct, measurement_window)

List every zero-touch XLA through (Custo.text:
Across the estate we have five zero-touch XLAs: three carry real credits when we miss, one is lighter, and one only demands a remediation plan.

- Credit-bearing XLAs: 4 total – Contoso Retail 3% weekly below 35%, Fabrikam Industries 5% weekly below 40%, Tailspin Airlines 2% monthly below 30%, Woodgrove Bank 3% monthly below 30%.  
- Non-credit XLA: 1 – Litware Insurance weekly below 40% triggers only a remediation plan.

### SOURCE
Ontology: ONT_ServiceDesk  
Path: (Customer)-[:CustomerHasContract]->(Contract)-[:ContractDefinesXla]->(Xla)  
Filter: Xla.metric = 'zero_touch_rate'  
Fields: customer_name, comparator, threshold, measurement_window, penalty_pct, clause_text  
Derived: consequence_group_label by penalty_pct and measurement_window  
Counts: XLAs per consequence_group_label, sum = total zero-touch XLAs
